meta.title: ctxvm tracer (W22)
meta.description: Mirror-mode xCABI trace capture for DeepSeek Harness sessions: writes a replayable JSONL trace per session and derives the page table.
meta.detail: Phase 1 of the W22 plan: observe-only capture from the session log, validated against spec/rfc-0 and replayed with ctxvm-conformance. No model-visible behavior change.
